questions.prompt: After Eagle's ascent stage was jettisoned into lunar orbit, what does the NSSDCA record say happened to it?

options.text: It was recovered and returned to Earth.
It is still tracked in a stable lunar orbit today.
Its fate is unknown, but it is assumed to have crashed into the Moon within 1 to 4 months.
It was left standing at Tranquility Base.

questions.explanation: NSSDCA states that the fate of the LM is not known, but it is assumed to have crashed into the lunar surface sometime within the following 1 to 4 months. The descent stage remained at Tranquility Base.

questions.prompt: Which crewed Apollo mission landed near Surveyor 3 and sent astronauts to examine it?
questions.explanation: The NSSDCA record states that Apollo 12 landed within about 180 m of Surveyor 3 on 19 November 1969. Pete Conrad and Alan Bean visited the spacecraft during their second moonwalk and removed about 10 kg of parts.

questions.prompt: What name was given to the Mars Pathfinder lander?
questions.explanation: The NSSDCA record names the lander the Sagan Memorial Station. It gives the landing site in the Ares Vallis region of Mars at 19.33 N, 33.55 W.

questions.prompt: How did Sojourner get from the lander onto the Martian surface?

options.text: It was dropped from orbit in a protective shell.
It extended to full height and rolled down a deployment ramp.
An astronaut placed it on the ground.
It was lowered by a sky crane.

questions.explanation: NSSDCA states that at deployment the rover extended to its full height and rolled down a deployment ramp at about 05:40 UT on 6 July 1997.
